inventory.interpretation: This is a supplemental-reference audit, not 69 rows with only file-level test evidence. Every file-only path in the inventory accompanies at least one named test reference in the same current ledger row. The machine-readable inventory retains the full list and sibling names; only three rows are semantically sampled here.

sampled_features.title: General stream syntax and stream-keyword separator
sampled_features.source_location: Primary physical p.46 / printed p.31. A stream is an indirect object with a direct stream dictionary; the `stream` keyword must be followed by LF or CRLF, not a bare CR. Data begins after that EOL marker and its extent is the dictionary Length.
sampled_features.assessment: Valid LF and CRLF controls, non-recovery controls, length precedence, and the chosen malformed-padding recovery are separately asserted. The corpus fax case is optional/machine-local; the exact synthetic tests are deterministic. The malformed padding policy is not itself a normative shall.

sampled_features.title: DeviceGray colour space
sampled_features.source_location: Primary physical p.197 / printed p.182, continuing to physical p.198 / printed p.183. A component is one number from 0.0 black to 1.0 white with intermediate gray levels; selecting DeviceGray initializes the corresponding current color to 0.0.
sampled_features.assessment: The assertions exercise g/G, cs/CS, sc/SC and an 8-bit DeviceGray image route, with exact black/white endpoints, intermediate values, initialization, and cross-route controls. Exact RGB byte outputs are the project's CPU-device mapping; the source separately warns that device-colour results can vary by device, so the byte-for-byte midtone oracle should not be cited as a universal ISO colorimetric requirement.

sampled_features.title: Text rendering mode
sampled_features.source_location: Primary physical p.318 / printed p.303; Table 104 is physical p.319 / printed p.304. Text mode combines fill, stroke, and clipping; those operations have path-equivalent effects and are parameterized in user space. Text clipping takes effect after text-object painting and lasts until a prior clip is restored.
sampled_features.assessment: The file-level citation is redundant to numerous named tests. The reviewed suite contains positive paint, distinct color, clip-timing, q/Q restoration, empty-outline, Type 3, and reporting cases. A separate hidden optional-content test covers the cross-clause clip persistence decision. No uncovered requirement was found in this sampled subset.

limits: Only the three sampled semantic rows were read against primary source and assertion bodies. The other 64 file-only references are preserved in inventory.json, not semantically certified by this artifact.

The inventory's named-sibling check proves only that the same ledger row also cites at least one ::test reference; it does not prove that the named test covers the file-only citation's intended feature.
No production behavior conclusion is drawn from a raw file-level citation alone. No test draft was justified by these three samples.
